earlier_manuscript_traceability: docs/integration/IEEE_TRACEABILITY.md maps the earlier MedTwin_IEEE_Manuscript_Final.docx, whose equation numbering (Eq. 1-16) differs from this draft (Eq. 1-12).

status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_AND_TESTED: Executable software exists and an automated test or saved artifact in this repository exercises the stated behaviour. Software evidence only; no clinical performance is implied.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VALIDATED: Executable software exists, but the evaluation the manuscript requires (annotated corpus, held-out data, user study) has not been run.
status_definitions.PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED: Part of the stated capability exists; the gap column lists what is missing.
status_definitions.PROPOSED_ONLY: Described in the manuscript; no implementation in this repository.
status_definitions.UNSUPPORTED: Cannot be supported with the evidence available; the application reports the claim as unavailable.

claims.claim: Each laboratory observation is the tuple o_j = (code_j, x_j, unit_j, [L_j, U_j], t_j, src_j, q_j) with the document/page/table span as source.
claims.gap: Code (curated LOINC, mapping unverified), value, comparison operator, unit, documented interval and inclusivity where explicit, documented date, source span/page, OCR page geometry, specimen, laboratory method/name and extractor version are stored. A scientifically calibrated per-value extraction quality q_j is not available.

claims.claim: Target registration error TRE = (1/K) sum ||T(p_k) - q_k|| is evaluated on landmarks disjoint from those used to fit T, against a prespecified threshold.
claims.gap: Exercised on synthetic landmarks only. No reviewed patient landmarks, threshold justification or held-out clinical registration benchmark exists.

claims.claim: Masked gated fusion alpha_k = m_k exp(e_k) / sum_j m_j exp(e_j) is defined only for a positive eligible denominator; zero or one valid modality bypasses fusion with an explicit state.
claims.gap: Tensor invariants are tested. No validated modality encoders or genuinely paired same-patient data exist, so case-level fusion abstains.

claims.claim: Delta x_j = x*_new - x*_old and r_j = Delta x_j / (t_new - t_old), on unit-compatible values, reported only when the comparability gates pass; otherwise NOT COMPARABLE.
claims.gap: Date, analyte, unit, specimen and laboratory-method comparability gates are enforced. Censored values abstain from exact arithmetic. Clinical interpretation, causal attribution and imaging deltas remain outside this equation.

claims.claim: A target- and horizon-specific forecaster y_hat(t+h) = f_theta(x(t-L+1:t), Delta t, c).
claims.gap: No forecasting model has been evaluated on a chronological held-out split. Both forecast endpoints return MODEL_NOT_VALIDATED; earlier persistence and linear extrapolations are no longer emitted.

claims.claim: Forecast error MAE and RMSE per target and horizon.
claims.gap: Computed from uploaded predictions only; no MedTwin forecaster has produced predictions to evaluate.

claims.claim: Accuracy, precision, sensitivity, specificity and F1 from a confusion matrix on independently labelled samples; never interchanged with case-level confidence.
Dice and IoU with a prespecified empty-mask convention.
claims.gap: 2D masks only, the validation kit's scope; multiclass averaging and 3D volumes are not evaluated.

claims.claim: Box IoU, with AP integrated over the precision-recall curve at prespecified IoU thresholds and mAP across classes.
claims.gap: Uses pycocotools COCOeval defaults (IoU 0.50:0.95); custom threshold sets are not configurable.

claims.claim: Brier score and expected calibration error.
claims.gap: ECE uses 10 equal-width bins; the value depends on that scheme.

claims.claim: Report 95% confidence intervals from independent-patient resampling where sample size permits.
claims.gap: Intervals are withheld below 20 rows or 5 per class.

claims.claim: Secure upload and semantic grouping of clinical documents, scans and recordings.
claims.gap: Grouping is by case, examination and detected modality, set by the uploader; there is no automatic grouping across files. No malware scanning.

claims.claim: Source-linked extraction of quantitative laboratory observations.
claims.gap: Rules-v2.0.0 now preserves comparison operators, laboratory/specimen/method context, source hashes/spans, OCR page geometry and documented intervals. The evaluation harnesses exist, but no lawful independently reviewed report corpus has been executed, so clinical extraction accuracy remains unvalidated.

claims.claim: Task-appropriate analysis of supported images and digital signals.
claims.gap: Reading, metadata and window/level rendering exist. Seven checkpointed 2-D image models can run only through a research-only applicability and artifact-integrity gate; PTB-XL has internal evaluation evidence but no upload inference. A reusable 3-D pipeline passed synthetic execution and an ACDC data audit, but real ACDC training is licence-blocked and has no checkpoint or metric. All remain not clinically or externally validated; EEG inference and task-specific image quality/OOD gates are unavailable.

claims.claim: Association and conditional fusion of findings from authorized case records.
claims.gap: Concordance and the fusion gate run; fusion itself needs a trained model and paired data.

claims.claim: Reliable old-versus-new comparisons.
claims.gap: Laboratory comparisons enforce unit/specimen/method context and exclude censored values; report statements use composite site/laterality/anatomy/context identities and abstain on repeated ambiguous matches. Serial imaging still returns REGISTRATION_UNAVAILABLE.

claims.claim: Conservative organ-level 3D visualization.
claims.gap: Automated Edge QA rendered all 43 registered variants across ten systems with WebGL counters and canvas-content checks. These are generic reference assets, not anatomically validated or patient-registered geometry.

claims.claim: Eligible, uncertainty-aware forecasts.
claims.gap: Eligibility gating, observed-evidence display and the target-trial specification exist; no validated forecaster, so every scenario is UNAVAILABLE.

claims.claim: A reproducible evaluation and human-review procedure.
claims.gap: Runs record input hashes, dataset, version, split, checkpoint, seed and code revision. Reporting eligibility requires exact registry/report/checkpoint/dataset/task/split and evaluator-byte agreement. Human findings and typed entity/measurement correction proposals preserve source output; there is no multi-reader adjudication protocol.

claims.claim: Document-only inputs yield findings, values and source locations with no organ-localized image output; longitudinal inputs compare aligned tests without inferring causality.
The parser detects format and imaging metadata instead of assuming a file is a diagnostic scan; a waveform screenshot is never treated as a calibrated waveform.
claims.gap: Bounded RFC-style CSV parsing handles quoted commas/newlines and rejects malformed or NUL-bearing input. Native ECG is accepted as lead-column CSV only; EDF, WFDB and DICOM waveform readers are not implemented. Single DICOM objects and NIfTI-1 are supported, but atomic multi-file DICOM-series assembly/ordering/completeness validation is unavailable.

claims.claim: React/TypeScript client with current-versus-prior bundles, document and scan viewers, lab trend charts, provenance, uncertainty status and a Three.js anatomical scene.
claims.gap: Automated Edge QA passed all 16 desktop and 16 responsive routes, 43/43 anatomy variants across ten systems, 7/7 explicitly bound 2-D image-model workflows, 10/10 trained-model report views, structured/censored labs, original-preserving correction proposals, strict Clinical NLP/OCR controls, request-ID correlation, hash-only/no-raw-text provenance, queue persistence and prognosis abstention with zero unexpected browser errors. Supplemental visible Chrome inspection opened the high-value correction, BMP/C-NMC, prognosis and anatomy paths. This is software acceptance evidence, not a usability, accessibility, cross-browser, anatomical or clinical validation study.

claims.claim: API gateway with authentication, case-level authorization, secure uploads, queue-backed workers, model registry, audit events and PostgreSQL metadata with encrypted storage.
claims.gap: A database-backed job queue with leases, retries, cancellation and a separate worker process is verified across process restarts; there is no Redis broker. Request IDs correlate success/error responses with audit events. Authorized local case erasure removes unique objects and preserves shared ones. Uploads use fail-closed AES-256-GCM in Compose, but SQLite metadata is plaintext; PostgreSQL, encrypted backups, legal retention schedules and secure-media erasure are untested.

claims.claim: Persist case identifier, asset hash, acquisition and processing dates, source file/page/region, modality, anatomical site, model name/version, quality gate, label ontology, calibrated score, review state and abstention reason.
claims.gap: Measurements retain comparison operators, interval boundaries, specimen/method/laboratory context, extractor version, source hashes/spans and OCR page boxes. Research classification stores a temperature-scaled internal-validation score with explicit semantics. A formal verified ontology and clinically calibrated per-field uncertainty remain incomplete; detection/segmentation scores remain uncalibrated.

claims.claim: Document identification, embedded-text extraction or OCR, table parsing, NER, negation and temporality, test-name standardization, unit extraction and quality validation.
claims.gap: Local RapidOCR reads pages without embedded text and records engine/confidence plus page coordinates; strict CER/WER and span/context/concept evaluators exist. PDF tables are read as text; DOCX/XLSX tables and bounded RFC CSV are parsed. Entities come from rules/scispaCy paths. No lawful representative independently annotated clinical corpus has been executed, so accuracy remains unvalidated.

claims.claim: Never silently substitute a default reference interval for a missing laboratory interval; missing context means INDETERMINATE.
Convert only compatible units with a verified factor, retaining the unconverted original.
Critical-result alerts require prevalidated clinical rules and a timely human escalation workflow.
claims.gap: No critical-result alerting exists, and none is generated without validated rules.

claims.claim: The modality router uses metadata (DICOM modality and series properties) before any classifier; window/level is modality-appropriate and enhanced views are marked as transformations.
claims.gap: CLAHE and other enhancement are not offered.

claims.claim: Task-specific classification, detection, segmentation and ECG/EEG models with predeclared versions, thresholds, modality restrictions and failure states.
claims.gap: Seven completed 2-D image bundles have frozen checkpoints, internal held-out reports, modality restrictions and research-only failure states. PTB-XL has weights and internal evaluation evidence but no upload inference path. A generic 3-D trainer produced a cardiac cine-MRI segmenter (owner-authorized research use) with held-out cardiac indices; it is evaluation evidence only, with no volume upload path. Inference reproduces each model's evaluated numeric precision. None is clinically activatable or externally validated; EEG weights and image OOD gates remain unavailable.

claims.claim: Isolated organ models, interior/exterior cuts, skeletal/muscular/vascular/nervous layers and a combined body scene; a translucent mode is a visual mode, not a radiograph.
claims.gap: Automated Edge QA rendered and orbited all 43 registered variants across ten systems using geometry counters plus canvas pixel checks. Visual-mode controls are not exhaustively pixel-diffed, and no asset is clinically or patient-specifically validated.

claims.claim: L1 shows a reference model; L2 displays a finding on a named region only after a valid anatomy association and checked registration; text-only findings label an organ, never an exact coordinate.
claims.gap: L2 named regions require clinician confirmation of the atlas structure; spatially registered lesion display remains REGISTRATION_UNAVAILABLE.

claims.claim: L3 patient-specific geometry from a reconstructed, registered volume.
claims.gap: Future work in the manuscript; not implemented.

claims.claim: Report concordance compares entities with assertion and temporal qualifiers; disagreement triggers REVIEW without replacing either finding.
claims.gap: Not evaluated on independently annotated paired reports (the MIMIC-CXR experiment).

claims.claim: Imaging regions are matched only after registration; bounding-box coordinates are never subtracted across unregistered views.
claims.gap: No registration exists, so imaging change is always REGISTRATION_UNAVAILABLE.

claims.claim: Intervention-versus-no-intervention scenarios require validated causal or mechanistic assumptions; forecast graphics show past observations and a NOT ELIGIBLE state.
claims.gap: Scenario A and B report UNAVAILABLE with the treatment effect NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; no 3D simulation of future anatomy is rendered.

claims.claim: A clinician-reviewed clinical reference layer (e.g. NLEM 2022 medicines list, follow-up protocols, patient education) that never chooses prescriptions or procedures.
claims.gap: Not implemented. The application makes no drug, dose or procedure recommendation.

claims.claim: Role-specific views for clinicians, students, patients and caregivers.
claims.gap: Roles are admin, clinician and researcher with case viewer/editor membership. There is no patient- or caregiver-facing view.

claims.claim: Every result distinguishes SOURCE-REPORTED, MODEL-SUGGESTED, INDETERMINATE, CLINICIAN-CONFIRMED and REQUIRES URGENT HUMAN REVIEW.
claims.gap: Source spans, research-model provenance, PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW, review decisions and INDETERMINATE positions exist under their own codes, not this exact five-class vocabulary. Research outputs are labelled RESEARCH_ONLY_NOT_CLINICALLY_VALIDATED rather than MODEL-SUGGESTED, and no urgent-review rule exists.

claims.claim: Document extraction experiment: field exact-match, unit validity, entity P/R/F1 and OCR error rate on an expert-labelled report set.
claims.gap: Field exact/unit scoring, exact and label-aware overlap entity precision/recall/F1, context/confusion accounting, terminology-link accuracy, and OCR CER/WER/exact-page scoring are implemented under strict de-identified dual-artifact contracts. Experiment NOT RUN on a lawful independently annotated representative clinical report set; document-level measurement-tuple accuracy is also not established.

claims.claim: Upper-limb radiograph study classification on MURA patient/study splits.
claims.gap: Evaluation harness only. MURA v1.1 is now on disk (archive 60, 40,009 images, 40,013/40,013 files verified) but excluded from training: the Stanford AIMI Research Use Agreement requires the user's own registration and the local copy arrived as a third-party download. Experiment NOT RUN until the user confirms their agreement.

claims.claim: ECG diagnostic label analysis on PTB-XL patient-level folds.
claims.gap: Executed once (2026-10-25) on the publisher's patient-disjoint folds (1-8 train, 9 validation, 10 test; overlap asserted 0): 5-superclass macro AUROC 0.917 (95% CI 0.909-0.925), macro F1 at validation thresholds 0.734, n=2163 ECGs / 1881 patients. Internal single-source evaluation only; no external ECG cohort, no rejection/abstention metrics, research-only.

claims.claim: Paired chest image/report concordance on MIMIC-CXR.
claims.gap: Experiment NOT RUN: credentialed data access and an image model are required.

claims.claim: Lesion detection (mAP, recall) and segmentation (Dice/IoU) on task-matched expert boxes and masks.
claims.gap: Internal held-out experiments ran on publisher-annotated public data: ARCADE stenosis detection n=300, mAP 0.0618/AP50 0.2029/AR100 0.3585; TEZ kidney-stone detection n=196, mAP 0.2312/AP50 0.6286/AR100 0.3600; ARCADE SYNTAX segmentation n=300, vessel Dice 0.6829/IoU 0.5352 (mean foreground Dice/image 0.3070); Kvasir-SEG n=120, Dice 0.7679/IoU 0.6696. Validation-kit re-scores reproduced headline metrics. Cardiac cine-MRI (ACDC, owner-authorized research use) 3-D segmentation on 50 frozen test patients / 100 ED-ES volumes: mean case macro Dice 0.750 (LV 0.812, myocardium 0.731, RV 0.707); LV ejection fraction vs reference-mask values MAE 9.1 points, bias -5.8, r 0.852; volumes are overestimated (no prespecified connected-component post-processing). Patient-level independence is often unverifiable, rare/absent classes limit interpretation, and no external, clinical or independently re-annotated expert test set was evaluated.

claims.claim: Longitudinal forecast model evaluated by MAE, RMSE, coverage and temporal holdout.
claims.gap: Error and interval-coverage scoring exist. Experiment NOT RUN: no longitudinal cohort or forecaster.

claims.claim: Anatomical mapping and application performance: held-out TRE; latency p50/p95, error rate and memory on authenticated load-test requests.
claims.gap: Local software benchmarks exist: the HTTP benchmark targets an unauthenticated catalog route, and the report-workflow benchmark exercises a synthetic upload-to-reload workflow. TRE has no landmark data. Neither measures clinical performance.

claims.claim: The result tracker binds each score to its source predictions, immutable checkpoint and code commit; only fixed held-out test sets are reported.
claims.gap: Server-computed evaluator-byte digest, locally re-hashed registered artifact, dataset/task/version/split, checkpoint bytes and code revision are recorded. Only one exact Kvasir held-out CSV currently satisfies every registry/report/input binding; altered bytes, legacy metadata-only runs and non-test splits remain EXPLORATORY. Uncommitted code is recorded as a warning, not a blocker.

claims.claim: Accuracy > 95% is asserted only on a defined evaluation set with sample counts, reference labels, a frozen checkpoint and an uncertainty interval.
claims.gap: Assessed on three internal public-dataset image-classifier splits. Kvasir v2 (n=1,202) reached accuracy 0.926, 95% CI 0.911-0.940. Exploratory GastroVision (n=1,225) reached 0.737, CI 0.713-0.761, with four classes below minimum support. C-NMC (n=1,867, 28 subject clusters) reached 0.807, cluster-bootstrap CI 0.659-0.894. The >95% objective is not met; no external or clinical evaluation set exists.

claims.claim: Authenticate and authorize case access; reject nonpermitted or malicious files; bind every asset to a verified case and acquisition date with hashes and provenance.
claims.gap: No malware scanning or sandboxed parsing.

claims.claim: Extract statements and laboratory observations with units, intervals, time and spans; flag uncertain fields for manual review.
claims.gap: Statements and measurements retain source spans, context, operators, lab provenance and OCR coordinates; every extracted item awaits clinician review. No scientifically calibrated per-field uncertainty score or lawful clinical-corpus accuracy result exists.

claims.claim: Quality-gate each image or signal, then run a validated task model or return NOT RUN / ABSTAIN.
claims.gap: Supported 2-D inputs can run seven registered internally evaluated image models after modality, licence, report and checkpoint-byte gates; outputs are research-only and pending review. PTB-XL is evaluation-only, while the ACDC 3-D trainer refuses real data without explicit authorization. Task-specific image quality/OOD gates, EEG inference and every clinically validated model remain unavailable, so unsupported inputs return NOT RUN / refusal.

claims.claim: Match only within the same verified case; compute same-analyte, same-unit deltas; compare images only after alignment QA.
Set the anatomical presentation level (L1 always, L2 after valid mapping, L3 only after verified reconstruction); never invent coordinates.
claims.gap: L1 and organ/region-level L2 are implemented; L3 is not.

claims.claim: Forecast only when longitudinal observations and a tested forecasting model meet predefined eligibility; otherwise NOT ELIGIBLE.
claims.gap: Every request is NOT ELIGIBLE (MODEL_NOT_VALIDATED) until a forecaster is evaluated.

claims.claim: Present original evidence and review status, persist the audit trail, and return no autonomous drug or procedure recommendation.
Use de-identified or authorized data; isolate cases; encrypt stored records; implement consent, retention and deletion procedures.
claims.gap: Upload requires a de-identification attestation, text is de-identified, cases are isolated, authorized local erasure is tested, and upload objects are AES-256-GCM encrypted with keys outside the repository. Reachable Git history still contains PHI and blocks sharing. The database/backups are not encrypted; consent records, legal retention schedules, secure-media erasure and tamper-evident audit retention are absent. No regulatory compliance is claimed.
